description:
Arkcon welcomes you to our recently refurbished one-bedroom apartment to rent on Church Road, Ballybrack.

This bright and modern one-bedroom apartment is ideally positioned in a highly convenient and well-connected location. The property has been finished to a high standard and is presented in excellent condition throughout.

The accommodation briefly comprises a spacious open-plan living and kitchen area, fully fitted with modern appliances, a generously sized double bedroom with ample storage, and a contemporary main bathroom.

Church Road is superbly located within walking distance of Ballybrack Village, offering a range of local shops, cafés, and amenities. Excellent transport links are available nearby including multiple Dublin Bus routes and easy access to the DART, providing quick and direct access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas.
